INSERT INTO "public"."semesters" ("name") SELECT DISTINCT "semester" FROM "public"."academic_performance_records" ON CONFLICT ("name") DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO "public"."study_groups" ("name", "suborganizationId") SELECT DISTINCT ap."groupName", sub."id" FROM "public"."academic_performance_records" ap JOIN "public"."organizations" org ON org."name" = ap."organization" JOIN "public"."suborganizations" sub ON sub."name" = ap."suborganization" AND sub."organizationId" = org."id" ON CONFLICT ("suborganizationId", "name") DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO "public"."disciplines" ("code", "name", "suborganizationId") SELECT DISTINCT ap."disciplineCode", ap."disciplineName", sub."id" FROM "public"."academic_performance_records" ap JOIN "public"."organizations" org ON org."name" = ap."organization" JOIN "public"."suborganizations" sub ON sub."name" = ap."suborganization" AND sub."organizationId" = org."id" ON CONFLICT ("suborganizationId", "code", "name") DO NOTHING

UPDATE "public"."academic_performance_records" ap SET "organizationId" = org."id", "suborganizationId" = sub."id", "semesterId" = sem."id", "studentId" = stu."id", "studyGroupId" = grp."id", "disciplineId" = dis."id" FROM "public"."organizations" org, "public"."suborganizations" sub, "public"."semesters" sem, "public"."students" stu, "public"."study_groups" grp, "public"."disciplines" dis WHERE org."name" = ap."organization" AND sub."name" = ap."suborganization" AND sub."organizationId" = org."id" AND sem."name" = ap."semester" AND stu."email" = lower(btrim(ap."studentEmail")) AND grp."name" = ap."groupName" AND grp."suborganizationId" = sub."id" AND dis."code" = ap."disciplineCode" AND dis."name" = ap."disciplineName" AND dis."suborganizationId" = sub."id"
